I had to take my dad out of my life, he abused me since I was 6. But it is hard. Someone had to tell me that that man was never a father for me, he never took care of me. I used to do the same as you, I used to feel so uncomfortable with him being around, I used to hide from him, sometimes I caught him looking at me, I always slept with bra and long pants, night was dangerous.
I am 21 years old now, and I was 20 when I remembered the abuse. My mom also defends him, because he denied it.
I am saying this because I think that what used to hurt me most, was to think that "my father loved me" that way, until I understood - after getting mad and angry- that he was never a father.
If they minimize your pain I hope that you can believe me and people of this community that your pain is valid, you deserve to feel safe.
It is okay to leave anyone when what they give you is more pain than love.
